subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback intentionally remain fail-closed until Meet reports micMuted: false, even when an existing setup previously progressed with unknown microphone state?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes runtime readiness and recovery behavior for existing browser-managed sessions; tests establish the implementation path, but only maintainers can accept the user-visible availability tradeoff.

options.title: Confirm explicit-unmuted policy
options.body: Keep the fail-closed browser-unverified state and require live evidence that normal unmute recovery remains usable.

options.title: Preserve permissive unknown-state behavior
options.body: Restore the prior readiness behavior and scope the branch to transcript and tab-recovery fixes until a separate policy decision is made.

recommendation.title: Confirm explicit-unmuted policy
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed browser-unverified state and require live evidence that normal unmute recovery remains usable.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged meeting-bot extraction that documented this exact deferred policy question and are the strongest available history owner.
